$M --type idea --text "DI: get_it plus injectable removes manual registration drift as features accumulate from RF01 through RF09"
$M --type idea --text "DI: riverpod as the DI layer unifies state and DI but fights the already-pinned flutter_bloc stack"
$M --type idea --text "Secure storage: flutter_secure_storage is Keychain-backed, the natural home for Supabase session tokens"
$M --type idea --text "Biometrics: local_auth handles Face ID and Touch ID directly, but PIN fallback has to be hand-built since local_auth only covers biometrics, not PIN"
$M --type idea --text "Combination: go_router plus a dio interceptor plus get_it, each piece owning exactly one cross-cutting concern"
$M --type idea --text "Combination: drift plus get_it plus dio lets RF06 AND-logic filters run as real SQL predicates against cached entries instead of in-memory filtering"
$M --type idea --text "Chart package: fl_chart is pure Dart with no native bridge, matches the iOS-only simplicity, fine for RF09 zero/one/more-than-30 scenarios"
$M --type idea --text "Chart package: syncfusion_flutter_charts is more polished out of the box but heavier than three rendering scenarios actually require"
$M --type idea --text "Secure storage plus biometrics plus DI: register the vault as one lazy singleton exposing an unlock-state stream consumed everywhere via DI, so no screen duplicates vault logic"
$M --type idea --text "Alternative vault package: biometric_storage wraps secure storage and biometric gating into one API, fewer total dependencies than the secure_storage plus local_auth combo"
$M --type idea --text "DI versus testing: get_it factory overrides are simpler to swap with mocktail fakes than injectable generated code, a concrete point in get_it favor given the RNF07 coverage target"
$M --type idea --text "Insight: PIN storage sits between secure storage and biometrics, a custom vault use case that tries biometric first then falls back to a securely-stored PIN hash is itself a reusable F000 artifact"
$M --type idea --text "Insight: nothing forces the seven free parameters to agree with each other, the real foundation risk is strong per-cell defaults that never compose, for example whether the HTTP client Either failure feeds the same Failure type the cache layer produces"

$M --type idea --text "Constraint: fvm-pinned Flutter and Dart version is real, turn it into an asset by committing .fvmrc in F000 day one so no later unit can silently drift"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: flutter_bloc only is real, asset is one base Cubit or Bloc helper in core defining the same loading-data-error shape so nine feature blocs do not reinvent it"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: Clean Architecture layering is real but the safety is imagined until enforced, add an import-linter rule in F000 rather than relying on a human promise"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: fpdart Either everywhere is real, asset is one Failure hierarchy in core, built once in F000, mapped from the 13 backend error codes, that every feature data layer reuses"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: mocktail for test doubles is real, asset is one fake HTTP client and fake clock pattern shipped from F000 that every later unit copies for the RNF07 80 percent target"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: whisper_ggml on-device speech-to-text belongs to RF02, but F000 should still decide where the native plugin or isolate boundary lives so RF02 does not invent app-wide threading alone"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: design_tokens.dart as single visual source is real, asset is generating it mechanically from prototype-extract.md section 3 instead of hand-transcribing, removing a whole class of RNF08 drift bugs"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: iOS portrait only actually removes work, no orientation handling, no tablet layouts, no Android shims, resist building for future portability nobody asked for"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: the fixed 5 minute background session timeout is simplest as one AppLifecycleState listener plus a timestamp in the auth-vault shell, not duplicated per screen"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: the device-only biometric or PIN vault has zero network failure modes to design for, only local_auth or PIN failure states, which is genuinely freeing"
$M --type idea --text "Challenge an imagined constraint: a frozen backend contract does not forbid a generated HTTP client, but codegen is still not worth it for roughly 25 endpoints on a solo timeline"
$M --type idea --text "Challenge an imagined constraint: three layers per feature does not mean three mandatory files, a thin presentation layer can be one file when a screen is simple, like the RF09 dashboard"
$M --type idea --text "Leverage point: of the fixed constraints, only the Failure hierarchy and the base bloc state shape are genuinely cross-feature infrastructure F000 must build directly"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: RNF09 needs 5 write endpoints times 3 failure types, 15 countable scenarios, F000 can pre-build one parametrized test harness so later units fill a table instead of writing 15 tests from scratch"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: RLS is enforced entirely server-side, so the client HTTP layer only needs to always attach the bearer token, simpler than it first looks"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: Supabase is the only backend, route around pulling in the full supabase_flutter package by treating Supabase purely as a dio base URL per the x-cerne-function convention, since auth and biometrics are handled separately"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: the apikey and Authorization header rules are easy to get wrong by hand each call, dissolve the risk by building the rule entirely into one dio interceptor so no feature code ever sets headers itself"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: audio must never leave the device, establish the whisper_ggml isolate or plugin boundary early so RF02 is not the first unit discovering threading problems"
$M --type idea --text "Reframe: a frozen backend is a gift for a solo project, no backend bugs to chase and no API renegotiation, F000 can be built entirely against the OpenAPI contract and fixtures"
$M --type idea --text "Reframe: the free-choices section is not freedom, it is risk ownership, whichever library F000 picks becomes load-bearing for nine more units with no external veto to catch a bad pick"
$M --type idea --text "Constraint: fvm is pinned per repository not per machine, F000 should fill the Running and verifying TODO in AGENTS.md with the exact fvm command sequence the moment the project scaffolds"

$M --type idea --text "Substitute: replace hand-written DTO and JSON mapping with freezed plus json_serializable codegen for Entry, ChatMessage and ExportJob"
$M --type idea --text "Substitute: replace per-feature loading-error-data state classes with one generic Resource sealed class shared from core"
$M --type idea --text "Substitute: replace a hand-rolled debounce Timer in RF06 with one reusable Debouncer utility in core used by any future debounced input"
$M --type idea --text "Combine: merge the HTTP client and the offline-cache read path behind one repository-facing helper that decides network versus cache, so features never choose that themselves"
$M --type idea --text "Combine: pair design_tokens.dart generation with a golden-screenshot test step so RNF08 visual fidelity is partly machine-checked, not just promised"
$M --type idea --text "Combine: merge the auth vault and session-refresh logic into one AppStartupGate that owns both, since RF03 and RF07 both hinge on the same expiry clock"
$M --type idea --text "Combine: drive the vault background timeout and the HTTP token-refresh timing from one shared app-lifecycle clock instead of two independent timers that could drift"

$M --type idea --text "Adapt: treat every screens multiple visible states, RF02 four states and RF04 three states, as instances of one generic view-state enum rather than nine bespoke ones"
$M --type idea --text "Magnify: invest more than F000 strictly needs in the fake-clock and fake-http test harness, since the RNF07 80 percent target multiplies across nine more units"
$M --type idea --text "Shrink: scope F000 navigation to exactly the skeleton the flowchart needs, splash to vault to home to side menu, nothing speculative beyond it"
$M --type idea --text "Put to other use: have the design-token generator also emit a ThemeData object, not just raw constants, so widgets read Theme.of(context) with less import noise while staying single-sourced"
$M --type idea --text "Put to other use: reuse the dio retry interceptor backoff policy for the RF05 export-job status polling instead of writing a separate poller"
$M --type idea --text "Eliminate: no home-grown JWT parsing, hold Supabase tokens as opaque and let auth/refresh and auth/session be the only source of truth for validity"
$M --type idea --text "Eliminate: no speculative future-platform abstractions, Android channel shims or tablet breakpoints, since iOS portrait only already forbids needing them"
$M --type idea --text "Eliminate: no shared god repository interface, keep each feature repository interface in its own domain layer per RNF06 even though centralizing looks tempting in F000"
$M --type idea --text "Eliminate: no generic BaseRepository with shared CRUD methods, independent repositories per feature with no shared base that could tempt cross-imports"
$M --type idea --text "Reverse: write the Failure hierarchy and the 15-scenario RNF09 harness before the first real HTTP call is wired, so every repository is built test-first against a known contract"
$M --type idea --text "Reverse: let the router itself redirect on a single AuthStatus stream via a redirect callback, so screens stay dumb instead of each screen checking auth state on build"
$M --type idea --text "Reverse: shape the shared save-use-case interface that RF10 needs in F000 before RF04 or RF01 exist, so RNF06 is satisfied by construction rather than retrofitted later"

$M --type technique --text "started First Principles Thinking"

$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: every repository must return Either Failure T, so the Failure shape should mirror the backend error shape plus exactly one local-only variant for failures that never touch the network"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: retryable is a server-asserted flag, so the try-again button logic should render purely on retryable being true, never on client-side guessing from error codes"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: session state is binary, valid or expired, so F000 needs exactly one SessionStatus stream that every bloc subscribes to, nothing else independently decides login state"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: the vault is 100 percent local, so rebuild it with no async Either plumbing at all, threading a synchronous local decision through the same Either as network calls would be over-engineering"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: entries are immutable with no PATCH or DELETE, so the entries repository interface should never expose update or delete methods, not even as unimplemented stubs"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: offline allows only viewing cached data, never writing, so write methods like createEntry and sendMessage should have no offline code path at all, no optimistic queueing to reconcile later"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: RF08 and RF10 are explicitly described as sharing the same failure-isolation pattern, that repetition in the spec is permission to build one isolatedSideEffect helper used by both instead of two parallel implementations"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: PII check and embedding happen inside POST /entries, so the client needs no PII-awareness logic at all, resist adding client-side pre-filtering for safety"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: the spec explicitly states no risk-signal detection as a scope decision, so F000 should not add defensive risk-detection hooks just in case, that door is deliberately closed"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: design_tokens.dart is the single source with zero hardcoded values allowed, rebuilding from scratch means no screen widget holds even one temporary literal color or number"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: no BLoC imports another BLoC directly is stated for RF07 but is really a whole-app pattern, cross-feature communication should be repository or stream level everywhere, not just in the timeline screen"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: chat messages never become entries automatically except the explicit RF10 action, so chat and entries should be modeled as genuinely separate aggregates in the folder structure, resisting a shared Record supertype"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: the background session timeout is fixed and explicitly not configurable, so it belongs as a hardcoded Duration constant in core, never exposed through Settings even as a hidden toggle"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: whisper_ggml never sends audio to the backend, so the RF02 domain use case should take raw audio in and text out with zero awareness of where transcription runs, keeping the constraint enforced by architecture not convention"
$M --type idea --text "Bedrock fact: the 13 backend error codes are a closed set, so the Failure-mapping function should switch over the enum with no default case, making a hypothetical 14th code a compile error instead of a silent runtime gap"

$M --type insight --text "Two of the free choices, secure storage and biometrics, are really one decision, the vault, not two independent parameters, worth collapsing in any eventual decision matrix"
$M --type insight --text "The shared failure-isolation wording for RF08 and RF10 reads as a spec-level hint toward one shared helper, not a coincidence of similar phrasing"
$M --type insight --text "F000 real deliverable is not picking seven libraries, it is building the two or three shared abstractions, Failure hierarchy, view-state shape, and auth-session gate, that make every later RF unit boring to implement"

$M --type question --text "Should F000 also decide the test-fixture strategy for shaping fake HTTP responses, given RNF09 needs 15 scenarios across only 5 write endpoints, or should that be deferred to each RF unit"
$M --type question --text "Is a relational cache like drift overkill if RF06 filters, source plus date range with AND logic, could be satisfied by simple in-memory predicates over a Hive-cached list, does the query complexity actually justify SQL"
